seoTitle: Binaural Beat Generator: Left and Right Tones
metaDescription: Play two slightly different sine tones, one in each ear, to create a binaural beat at the difference frequency. Stereo headphones needed.
intro: Generate a binaural beat tone with exact frequencies.
why:
Set a base tone (50 to 1000 Hz), the beat frequency (0.5 to 40 Hz) and a volume. The left ear plays the base tone and the right ear plays base plus beat, panned hard left and right. The perceived beat equals the difference.

Evidence that binaural beats change mood, focus or sleep is mixed and the effects are small. This is not a medical device. Keep the volume low, do not use it while driving and stop if you feel unwell.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Set base tone, beat and a low volume.

faq.a: Each ear must hear a different tone; speakers mix them before they reach your ears.
Delta 0.5-4 Hz, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 12-30. Claims about each range are not well proven.
